__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Grafana Cloud hosted Prometheus (Mimir) data source

panels.title: Sync runs started
panels.description: New Moodle sync runs (Sync all or POST /api/scan/runs) in the selected range; replays are not counted.

targets.expr: round(sum((increase((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_sync_runs_started_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m]) and max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_sync_runs_started_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_sync_runs_started_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Active sync runs
panels.description: Sync runs that currently have a pending or running job (latest value).

panels.title: Personal events created
panels.description: Personal events created in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum((increase((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_personal_events_created_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m]) and max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_personal_events_created_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance) (moodlehelper_personal_events_created_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Personal event failures
panels.description: Personal event creations that raised in the selected range, any error type (includes validation errors that become 4xx).

targets.expr: round(sum((increase((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance, error_type) (moodlehelper_personal_events_failures_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m]) and max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance, error_type) (moodlehelper_personal_events_failures_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"} offset $__range)) or max_over_time((max by (deployment_environment_name, service_version, instance, error_type) (moodlehelper_personal_events_failures_total{job="moodlehelper-backend", deployment_environment_name="$environment", service_version=~"$version"}))[$__range:1m])))

panels.title: Active sync runs over time
panels.description: Sync runs with a pending or running job.
